    print(f"Processed {f['filename']}")

    x_col = next((c for c in cols if 'shift' in c.lower() or 'cm-1' in c.lower() or 'wavenumber' in c.lower()), cols[0])
    y_col = next((c for c in cols if 'intensity' in c.lower() or 'counts' in c.lower() or 'y' in c.lower()), cols[1])
    
    x = f['table'][x_col]
    y = f['table'][y_col]
    
    plt.plot(x, y, label=f['filename'])
    print(f"Columns used: x={x_col}, y={y_col}")

plt.legend()
plt.xlabel('Raman Shift (cm-1)')
plt.ylabel('Intensity')
plt.title('Polystyrene Spectra')
plt.show()
